hardest_target_interaction.sub_concept: Linear sp Hybridisation & Orthogonal Double Pi Systems (CO2)
hardest_target_interaction.interaction_description: Interactive 4-stage exploration of CO2: Stage 1 reveals the 2 Lewis domains (double bonds acting as single domains); Stage 2 isolates the linear sp sigma framework (180 degrees along the x-axis); Stage 3 reveals the two mutually perpendicular unhybridised 2p orbitals (2py in vertical y, 2pz in depth z); Stage 4 activates lateral side-on overlap to form two independent orthogonal pi systems with terminal oxygen atoms, providing an interactive orbital accounting check to verify that all 4 carbon valence orbitals are used with zero double-counting.
hardest_target_interaction.diagnostic_hypothesis: Learners struggling with multi-bond hybridisation typically assume either that carbon requires sp3 to form 4 bonds or that both pi bonds in CO2 occupy the same plane, causing electronic clash. The staged interaction resolves this by visually demonstrating the orthogonality of 2py and 2pz.
